clue.text: See noisy silly person settle for imaginary, impractical scheme

parts.note: the letter C is pronounced the same as the word see
noisy means loud
a cuckoo is informal for a crazy or foolish person
to land is to settle or come down to rest

explanation.surface: Someone is told to look at a loud fool and accept a fanciful, unworkable plan.
explanation.walkthrough: C for 'See' depends on how the letter is said; the blog doubted noisy as LOUD, but loud and noisy are near enough synonyms.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase from Aristophanes names a realm of fantasy, so it describes any dreamy plan with no hope of working.

clue.text: One's fuel consumption is about right? Sadly no on trip to Belgium and France

parts.note: B is the international vehicle code for Belgium
F is the international vehicle code for France

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether skipping a trip to Belgium and France is the right call for their fuel use.
explanation.definitionFit: The measure of greenhouse emissions a person causes is their environmental impact from burning fuel.

clue.text: Short cut's taken by person at just the right moment

indicators.note: short means the word cut loses its final letter

parts.note: cut is taken as written before it is shortened

explanation.surface: A shortcut is taken by someone who arrives exactly when needed.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor entering at the prompt arrives exactly when required, hence the idiom for perfect timing.

explanation.definitionFit: A dastard is a contemptible coward or villain, an old word for a cad.
